tools.name: geocode_address
tools.title: Geocoding: Geocode Address
tools.description: Use this tool when the input is one free-text address, landmark, city, or place query and coordinates are needed. Use geocode_structured_address when address components are already separated, or reverse_geocode_coordinates when the input is coordinates.

query.description: Street address or free-text location query to geocode.

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return.

lang.description: Result language as a supported two-letter language code.

country_codes.description: Optional ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code filters, for example "de" or "us". Values are case-insensitive and normalized to lowercase.

outputSchema.description: Compact geocoding result for a free-text query.

query.description: Normalized query supplied to the tool.

items.description: Compact MCP projection of a public Geoapify geocoding result.

rank.description: Match quality, confidence, importance, and popularity metadata.

timezone.description: Timezone information for the result location.

bbox.description: Result bounding box in WGS84 longitude/latitude coordinates.

tools.name: search_places
tools.title: Places: Search Places
tools.description: Use this tool to find places of one exact supported category around known coordinates. Call list_place_categories first when the category is unknown, and geocode an address first when the search center is not yet coordinates.

category.description: Place category to find. Call list_place_categories first to get the supported category values.

radius_meters.description: Optional search radius in meters. When omitted, returns the nearest matching places without a hard distance limit.

limit.description: Maximum number of places to return.

lang.description: Result language as a supported two-letter language code.

outputSchema.description: Places matching one category around a coordinate.

category.description: The supported place category used for this search.

radius_meters.description: Applied search radius in meters when supplied.

items.description: Public place properties after the MCP compact-output filters are applied. Besides the listed fields, a place can include address components (country, state, city, postcode, street, housenumber), opening_hours, website, brand, operator, and detail groups such as contact, facilities, catering, and accommodation. See the focused tool specification for the complete contract.

datasource.description: Data source with attribution and license details.

results.description: Matching places ordered by proximity and relevance.

tools.name: list_place_categories
tools.title: Places: List Place Categories
tools.description: Use this zero-credit tool to discover the exact category value required by search_places. It accepts no arguments and returns category names only; use search_places afterward to find actual places.

categories.description: Exact category strings accepted by search_places.

tools.name: calculate_route
tools.title: Routing: Calculate Route
tools.description: Use this tool for one ordered route with total and per-leg travel cost plus optional geometry or turn instructions. Use calculate_route_matrix instead to compare travel times and distances across many source-target pairs.

waypoints.description: Ordered route waypoints. Provide at least an origin and destination.

mode.description: Travel or vehicle mode used to calculate the route.

avoid.description: Route features to avoid. Supported values are "tolls", "ferries", and "highways".

geometry_scope.description: Geometry detail to return: none, route only, route and legs, or route, legs, and instruction steps.

geometry_format.description: Return geometry as a GeoJSON geometry object or an encoded precision-5 polyline.

optimize_stops.description: Optimize the order of intermediate stops while preserving the first and last waypoint.

traffic.description: Traffic model used for motorized routing.

outputSchema.description: Route totals, resolved waypoints, legs, and optional geometry.

time.description: Estimated total travel time in seconds.

items.description: A resolved location in latitude/longitude form.

waypoints.description: Resolved route waypoints in request order, or optimized order when enabled.

items.description: A [longitude, latitude] pair; longitude is -180 to 180 and latitude is -90 to 90.
A [longitude, latitude] pair; longitude is -180 to 180 and latitude is -90 to 90.

legs.description: Route segment between each consecutive waypoint pair.

items.description: A [longitude, latitude] pair; longitude is -180 to 180 and latitude is -90 to 90.
A [longitude, latitude] pair; longitude is -180 to 180 and latitude is -90 to 90.

geometry.description: Optional route geometry in the requested geometry format.

tools.name: calculate_route_matrix
tools.title: Routing: Calculate Route Matrix
tools.description: Use this tool to compare pairwise travel times and distances between multiple sources and targets. It does not return route geometry or instructions; use calculate_route for one detailed ordered route.

sources.description: Matrix source locations. sources.length multiplied by targets.length must not exceed 1000.

targets.description: Matrix target locations. Defaults to the source locations when omitted. sources.length multiplied by targets.length must not exceed 1000.

mode.description: Travel or vehicle mode used to calculate the matrix.

traffic.description: Traffic model used for motorized routing.

avoid.description: Route features to avoid. Supported values are "tolls", "highways", and "ferries".

outputSchema.description: Resolved matrix locations and source-to-target travel costs.

items.description: A resolved location in latitude/longitude form.
A resolved location in latitude/longitude form.

sources_to_targets.description: Rows correspond to sources and columns correspond to targets.

distance_units.description: Unit used by matrix distance values.

time_units.description: Unit used by matrix time values.
